title: 请带他回去

source.prompt: TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental. Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 72 BPM, short original five-second serious injury notification cue: restrained descending woodwind notes over a soft low chord, compassionate and unresolved but calm. No funeral march, no death scream, no horror impact. Natural quiet tail and then silence. A single short complete musical notification, not a song or repeating loop. Resolve the final cadence by 5 seconds, then let the final note decay naturally into quiet silence. No new phrase after the final chord.
source.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, loud sound effects, abrupt stop

editing.method: preserve full onset, search low-energy cadence; retain full source when no natural early tail found

auditory_review_note: Objective measurements only; no claim of human or model listening. Music content, absence of vocal textures and phrase coherence still need listening.
